description: This Mendeley Data deposit supports optimisation of electric-vehicle charging in a benchmark 0.4 kV distribution network. The dataset authors report simulated changes in cable loading, node voltage and network losses as the number of charging vehicles increases. Version 4, published in 2020, is publicly accessible under CC BY 4.0; the repository page identifies the resource, although its file formats were not exposed in the metadata inspected. The results can be reused to compare charging-control strategies and assess distribution capacity under transport electrification. Coverage is a numerical network case, and the reported improvements depend on its Monte Carlo sampling and optimisation objectives. They do not establish performance for arbitrary real feeders. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
